faq.a: Stratum is a vehicle listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki, made in game by Zirconium. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Stratum as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Stratum?
faq.a: The wiki gives 5 details. Manufacturer: Zirconium. Class: Sedans. Body style: 4-door station wagon. Seats: 4. Listed price: $10,000 (from GTA Online, not GTA 6). Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Stratum information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Stratum, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Stratum?
faq.a: Most of it. Stratum rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Top speed, handling and stats and a gta 6 price are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Stratum be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of vehicle entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
